episodes.title: Diplos
episodes.summary: Two doctors investigate the maiming and death of patients at the hands of a Dallas neurosurgeon.

episodes.title: Ain't No Bum
episodes.summary: Henderson and Kirby try to strip Duntsch of his medical license; Duntsch joins the football team.

episodes.title: Dock Ellis
episodes.summary: Duntsch meets his mentor; Henderson and Kirby explore the medical system.

episodes.title: An Occurrence at Randall Kirby's Sink
episodes.summary: Henderson and Kirby crash a function in Duntsch's honor; Duntsch sets up his practice in Texas.

episodes.title: The $?!& in the Bed
episodes.summary: Duntsch begins operating in Dallas; Henderson and Kirby gain an ally in stopping Duntsch.

episodes.title: Occam's Razor
episodes.summary: Duntsch attempts to fix a disastrous surgery; Shughart builds her case against Duntsch.

episodes.title: Feet of Clay
episodes.summary: Duntsch tries to mount a defense; Henderson, Kirby and Shughart seek answers to lingering questions.

episodes.title: Hardwood Floors
episodes.summary: Duntsch's victims confront him as Henderson, Kirby and Shughart set out to put him behind bars.

episodes.title: Like Magic
episodes.summary: Dr. Paolo Macchiarini performs a breakthrough surgery and starts a relationship with a journalist.

episodes.title: Worth the Risk
episodes.summary: Macchiarini's surgeries in 2012 and 2013 have disparate outcomes; Paolo and Benita grow closer.

episodes.title: The Horizon
episodes.summary: In 2012, another Dr. Macchiarini surgery ends tragically; Benita begins suspecting Paolo.

episodes.title: Tarantela Telaraña
episodes.summary: Doctors in Sweden suspect Macchiarini is experimenting on people; Benita sees through Paolo's lies.
Dr. Gamelli tries to keep Macchiarini's latest patient alive and raises concerns about the surgery.

episodes.title: The Fog
episodes.summary: Dr. Lasbrey makes a shocking discovery; Benita realizes Paolo's lies go deeper than she thought.

episodes.title: Compassionate Uses
episodes.summary: The doctors in Sweden blow the whistle on Paolo but face the consequences; Benita shares her story.

episodes.title: Surgeons, Bachelors and Butchers
episodes.summary: The doctors defend their findings; Swedish authorities make a decision about Macchiarini's case.
